mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.order_type, o.member_id, m.real_name AS member_name, o.session_id, o.total_amount, o.discount_amount, o.payable_amount, o.paid_amount, o.status, o.remark, o.operator_id, e.real_name AS operator_name, o.paid_at, o.created_at, o.updated_at FROM orders o LEFT JOIN member m ON o.member_id = m.id AND m.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN employee e ON o.operator_id = e.id AND e.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
